title: Finite partial sum representatives for cohomology of a coproduct on a qcqs scheme
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I an arbitrary index type, F_i sheaves of O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and S a coproduct of the F_i with inclusions iota_i [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For every nonnegative p and x in H^p(X,S) [pqf-def-cohomology], there exist a finite subset J of I and y in H^p(X,B_J), where B_J is the finite biproduct of the F_j in the abelian category [def-sp-abelian], such that H^p(X,kappa_J)(y)=x. Here kappa_J is the unique map whose composite with each biproduct inclusion is iota_j. The empty finite subset is permitted.

source.place: Cohomology, Tag 01FF, label lemma-quasi-separated-cohomology-colimit, lines 3194-3211; direct-sum application in Tag 09J7, label lemma-perfect-is-compact, lines 13762-13768. Only the finite-stage existence assertion is used.

proof.text: Use exists_small_finiteSubsum_diagram to obtain a small nonempty directed finite-subsum diagram with colimit S and biproduct component equations. This isolates all universe reduction and categorical presentation work.

Use the proved natural scalar-forgetting top-open comparison. Mathlib PrespectralSpace.isTopologicalBasis for schemes supplies the compact-open basis (AlgebraicGeometry.Properties); X is compact. Apply the existence-of-stage clause of openModuleCohomology_directedColimit at the top open to the small diagram, on the image of x under the comparison.

Transport the stage class back through the inverse comparison. Its naturality and the hom-inverse identity prove its image is x. Transport along the stage biproduct isomorphism; component equations and biproduct.hom_ext identify the cocone leg with the original biproduct descent. Functoriality gives the required equality.

lean.statement:
theorem moduleCohomology_finiteSubsum_representative (X : Scheme.{u})
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (I : Type v)
    (F : I → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (S : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ι : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ S)
    (_hS : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) (p : ℕ)
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj S) :
    ∃ (J : Finset I)
      (y : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj (⨁ (fun j : J ↦ F j))),
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).map
        (biproduct.desc (fun j : J ↦ ι j))).hom y = x
